# matrix value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:matrixValue`](gmeow-matrixValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/matrixValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

The serialised numeric content of a [`CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) — a vector, matrix, or tensor expressed as a literal (e.g. a JSON array, a WKT-like tuple string, or a base64-encoded binary blob). The serialisation format is frame-specific and is interpreted by the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

Use [`gmeow:matrixValue`](gmeow-matrixValue.md) from [`gmeow:CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
